title: Staged SAML metadata approval: exchange logs, validation pipeline, and RBAC-gated admin signoff
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a staged SAML 2.0 metadata ingestion and validation pipeline that surfaces a compact diff, runs a simulated assertion dry-run, and requires an RBAC-gated admin signoff before activating new IdP metadata. This ticket covers backend validators, exchange logging for audit trails, the signoff API, and the small console surface to review diffs and approve/reject. The goal is to reduce onboarding errors for SSO customers and create an auditable path for metadata changes tied to RBAC v2 permissions (saml.manage).
acceptance_criteria: Metadata uploader accepts XML or URL and persists a candidate metadata bundle in staging (not active).
Automated validators run: XML well-formedness, signature presence/validity (when applicable), entityID normalization, certificate sanity checks, binding compatibility, and URL safety scans.
System generates a human-readable diff (added/removed endpoints, cert changes, EntityID changes) and stores a compact summary in the exchange log.
Dry-run assertion simulator can be run against the staging metadata and returns simulated SAML responses and mapped attributes without creating production sessions.
UI shows diff, validation results, last-seen fingerprints, and risk hints; only users with RBAC role granting 'saml.manage' can Approve/Reject.
Approvals write an immutable audit entry with actor, timestamp, metadata fingerprint, decision, and optional admin note. Rejections must record rationale.
Fallback: if an active IdP stops responding after metadata activation, system can automatically revert to previous active metadata within N minutes (configurable) and log the incident.
End-to-end tests cover upload -> validate -> dry-run -> approve -> activation and activation -> simulated outage -> automatic rollback path.
All produced logs comply with audit retention config and include request IDs to correlate with support tickets and incident traces.
implementation_notes: Backend validator service reuses pieces from existing metadata-forensics module but adds a staging bucket and signature verification adapter that supports both signed metadata and cert-based trust anchors. Exchange logging must use structured events (timestamp, actor, op, fingerprint) and be write-once. The signoff API should validate the caller's RBAC claims via token introspection and deny actions if 'saml.manage' is not present. Plan to add a lightweight job that periodically prunes staging bundles older than 30 days if not approved.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Malformed metadata could block onboarding. Mitigation: prefer non-blocking UX where validation errors are flagged and detailed remediation hints are shown; allow admin override only after explicit risk acknowledgement.
Risk: Audit logs leak sensitive cert material. Mitigation: redact full cert bodies in logs; store fingerprint/hash and reference to secure blob storage with restricted ACLs.

Risk: Rollback could cause session discontinuities. Mitigation: make rollback window configurable and send alerts to SRE and customer-facing team; add Canary activation option for high-risk customers.
Risk: RBAC gaps allow unauthorized approvals. Mitigation: require explicit 'saml.manage' permission and add an additional optional MFA gating for high-value tenants.
